Frankrike: kvalificerad permanentbostad: France: a qualifying main residence and an owner’s sale proceeds up to EUR 15,000 are exempt. Other private property is taxed at 19% income tax and 17.2% social charges on separately holding-period-adjusted bases (fully exempt after 22 and 30 years respectively), plus a surcharge above EUR 50,000 taxable gain. Cost basis must already include verified deductible costs; no standard additions are applied again automatically. Tax is paid at the notary and credited exactly once at annual settlement.
2025 income, 2026 barème and return. Separate single-person tax households, ordinary quotient familial with a EUR 1,807 cap per additional half-share, and décote. Salary is gross cash salary. Enter actual total and deductible employee contributions and taxable salary additions from the payslip. Net taxable salary is gross less deductible contributions plus additions; work expenses are then deducted. Actual total social contributions are booked separately as a cash charge. PFU only: 2025 dividends 30%, securities gains assessed in 2026 31.4%. Joint filing/PACS, barème election, special family caps and high-income CEHR/CDHR are excluded.
